Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling • Homophones • Words with double consonants • Words with double vowels

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.4.1 Spelling • Homophones • Words with double consonants • Words with double vowels, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we write words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.4.1 Spelling • Homophones • Words with double consonants • Words with double vowels together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: Articulating signs clearly as learner observes, fingerspell and sign words related to the theme; money- savings

• Creativity and problem solving: Making observation as learner make words from jumbled up letters

Values:
• Responsibility: Determination as learners write down from a dictation correctly

• Unity: Cooperation as learner creates puzzles and rearrange jumbled up sentences in pairs or groups

Link to other Subjects:

Learners relates spelling and fingerspelling words correctly to their learning in all learning areas.
